manifest.method: Serial, same Float32 PCM; prepared input to PCM24 WAV plus two DeMan loudness passes; excludes decode, startup/import and disk output. Browser Worker includes chunk transport.

speed.scope: Same prepared PCM; full-safe, one serial run per duration; includes repair, two loudness measurements, WAV encoding; excludes source/B decode, startup, caching. Python has no Numba.

limitations: Synthetic signals plus one speech recording. No real-song blind listening, mobile memory stress, GPU/multithread benchmark, Numba-enabled Python comparison or arbitrary-input byte identity guarantee.
